title: 343. Number of Digit One

examples.explanation: The digit 1 occurs once each in 1, 10, 12, 13, and twice in 11.
The only value considered is 0, which contains no digit 1.

hints: Process the number one decimal position at a time using a place factor of 1, 10, 100, ...
For each position, split n into higher, current, and lower parts to count full cycles plus any partial cycle.
